long_biography.plain_text:
Angus R. Cooper II entered the waterfront business built by his grandfather and enlarged by his father, Ervin. Born in Mobile, he studied at the University of Alabama before joining Cooper Stevedoring after graduation in 1964. He and his brother David sought to take the enterprise beyond its established American port base and compete in international markets. The family company grew from cargo handling into a network of related marine operations.

The Cooper Group now encompasses terminal work, ship-assist tugs, barges, warehousing, logistics and vessel repair, with activity on all three US coasts and in Mexico. Angus has long chaired and led its central corporation, while his sons Angus III and Scott have taken operating roles in the next generation. His maritime work has also been recognized by the International Maritime Hall of Fame and Alabama Business Hall of Fame. In Mobile he has supported civic institutions, including the Senior Bowl and maritime education.
